summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Ayam Fillet purchase feature. All backend APIs (41/41 tests) and frontend UI flows passed successfully. Feature allows purchasing Ayam Fillet with pcs units, dynamic label switching, correct stock tracking (kg + pcs), and proper CRUD operations.
passed_tests: Backend: Login with owner/admin123 credentials
Backend: GET /api/products returns Ayam Fillet and Ayam Broiler with correct stock fields
Backend: GET /api/suppliers returns supplier list
Backend: POST /api/purchases with mixed items (Broiler 10 ekor + Fillet 5 pcs) - Response structure correct with qty_unit='pcs' for Fillet, qty_unit='ekor' for Broiler
Backend: Fillet item in response has ekor=0, pcs=5, avg_weight=0.8
Backend: Broiler item in response has ekor=10, pcs=0, avg_weight=2.0
Backend: Purchase response totals: total_ekor=10, total_pcs=5
Backend: Stock verification after purchase - Fillet stock_kg +4, stock_pcs +5, stock_ekor unchanged (0)
Backend: Stock verification after purchase - Broiler stock_kg +20, stock_ekor +10
Backend: Fillet units array contains 'pcs' after purchase
Backend: GET /api/stock-movements shows movement type='pembelian' for Fillet with qty_kg=4, qty_pcs=5, qty_ekor=0
Backend: PUT /api/purchases updates Fillet quantity (3 pcs, 2 kg) - Stock correctly adjusted to initial +2 kg, +3 pcs
Backend: DELETE /api/purchases reverses all stock changes - Fillet and Broiler stocks return to initial values
Backend: Regression test - Purchase with only whole chicken (Broiler 2 ekor, 4 kg) works correctly
Frontend: Login as owner successful
Frontend: Navigate to /pembelian page loads correctly
Frontend: Click 'Pembelian Baru' button opens modal
Frontend: Product dropdown shows both 'Ayam Fillet' and 'Ayam Broiler'
Frontend: Select Ayam Fillet - Label changes to 'Jumlah (pcs)'
Frontend: Select Ayam Fillet - Unit text in input box shows 'pcs'
Frontend: Fill values (5 pcs, 4 kg, 200000) - Hint shows '0,8 kg/pcs' calculation
Frontend: Summary displays 'Perkiraan Harga/kg' correctly
Frontend: Summary displays total pcs count with testid 'pur-total-pcs'
Frontend: Switch product to Ayam Broiler - Label changes back to 'Jumlah (ekor)'
Frontend: Switch to Broiler - Hint changes to show '/ekor'
Frontend: Switch to Broiler - Summary shows 'Modal Efektif/ekor'
Frontend E2E: Create purchase with Ayam Fillet (5 pcs, 4 kg, Rp 200,000)
Frontend E2E: Purchase saved successfully with toast notification
Frontend E2E: Purchase appears in Pembelian table
Frontend E2E: Navigate to /stok page - Ayam Fillet card shows Pcs increased by 5
Frontend E2E: Navigate to /stok page - Ayam Fillet card shows Berat increased by 4 kg
Frontend E2E: Delete purchase via trash icon and confirmation
Frontend E2E: Stock returns to initial values after deletion (Pcs and Berat)

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all UI flows and E2E tests passed)
